build_box_head_from_config: build a box head from a detectron2 config using build_box_head with cfg and input_shape
create_FastRCNNConvFCHead_with_conv_fc: create a FastRCNNConvFCHead with conv and fc layers by passing input_shape, conv_dims, and fc_dims
register_custom_box_head: register a custom box head class in ROI_BOX_HEAD_REGISTRY for use with build_box_head
forward_FastRCNNConvFCHead: run forward pass through a FastRCNNConvFCHead to transform region features into box prediction features
inspect_FastRCNNConvFCHead_output_shape: inspect the output_shape property of FastRCNNConvFCHead to get the ShapeSpec of output features
